question: How accurately do Metron's fixed RMR equation outputs agree with independently measured indirect-calorimetry RMR in eligible adult cohorts?

scope.population: Adults with appropriately measured RMR; cohort-specific inclusion/exclusions to be frozen at G1

phases.name: Source eligibility and rights audit
phases.goNoGo: At least one lawfully analyzable cohort; otherwise report blocker
evidenceReviewed: Zenodo cc-by-4.0 record rights and direct public file downloads
Four actual release files inspected; all MD5 matched and SHA-256 recorded
enable_data.tsv 459 distinct participant IDs, 454 positive numeric measured RMR and joint available fields
Source article documents enable indirect-calorimetry procedure, separate Kiel method and SECA bioimpedance FFM
phases.decision: Qualified enable_data.tsv for G1 protocol design; other sources not admitted

phases.name: Freeze statistical analysis protocol
phases.decision: Fixed cohort bounds, reference conversion, model comparison/FFM eligibility, metrics, site-stratified 5000-replicate participant bootstrap, and subgroups before calculating errors

phases.name: Implement and audit benchmark CLI
phases.goNoGo: Reproducible passing tests and independent numeric verification

phases.name: Run empirical benchmark and publish evidence
phases.goNoGo: Reproducible report or explicit irreducible data blocker

phases.name: Review model implications without automatic adoption
evidenceNeeded: ADR only if consequential code/claim changes
phases.goNoGo: Keep default unless changes are supported and independently reviewed

needs: measured FFM kg or documented legitimate BF estimate
conditional.pairedEligibility: Only compare Mifflin and Cunningham on identical eligible participant rows

restrictions: Do not infer equation-sex from gender identity
Do not treat estimated RMR as independent reference
Do not train on or tune against benchmark outcomes
Do not confuse measured RMR with doubly labeled water TDEE

reporting.confidence: 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for dataset-level metrics, seed and resampling unit preregistered at G1; not individual prediction intervals

trackedStatusMeaning.not-started: no gate evidence has been submitted
trackedStatusMeaning.blocked: cannot proceed without specific missing evidence/permission
